text: Bug #1 (errors.go) fixed: `Unwrap()` was declared on the pointer receiver `*Error` while `Error()` is on the value receiver, so a `gin.Error` value satisfied `error` but could not be unwrapped by `errors.Is/As/Unwrap`. `Unwrap` is now on the value receiver, so both values and pointers unwrap correctly. Full `go test ./...` passes.

Bug #4 (tree.go, case-insensitive lookup) fixed: in `findCaseInsensitivePathRec`, after the non-wildcard-children branch the code did `n = n.children[0]`, but the wildcard child is always kept at the END of the children array (`addChild`, and `getValue` uses `children[len-1]`). So for a node with several children plus a wildcard, the lookup picked a regular child and panicked with "invalid node type". It now selects `n.children[len(n.children)-1]`. Verified: `findCaseInsensitivePath` no longer panics and returns the case-corrected path for such trees; full `go test ./...` passes.
